description: One delivery of an event to a webhook. The event's content is never returned

message_id.description: The message id: sent as the webhook-id header on every try and redelivery

status.description: Where the delivery is: pending, sending, sent, failed (no more tries) or dropped (the webhook was disabled or deleted)

next_try_on.description: When the next try is due; null when none is waiting

http_status.description: The HTTP status of the last try; null when there was none or the request did not get an answer

duration_ms.description: How long the last try took in milliseconds

error.description: Why the last try failed, without the URL or any secret; null when it did not fail

response.description: The first 2 KB of the receiver's last answer, with the URL and secrets hidden

redeliverable.description: Whether the content is still kept, so the delivery can be redelivered. A failed delivery keeps it for 7 days
